text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once, Mei Satake had witnessed with her 
own eyes Speed Symboli becoming the first 
Japanese Umamusume to challenge the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume supposedly trailing the world 
in skill and technique—yet her running was 
so captivating that it left a deep 
impression on Mei Satake's heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After her defeat in the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, what that Umamusume sought to 
pass down—even at the cost of retiring— 
was how to challenge the barrier known as 
the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Those chasing romance unite as one— Mei 
Satake continues to wait for an Umamusume 
to emerge who can surpass Speed Symboli.
